📖 How to use

  1. Press Start to get your first question.
  2. Pick one of the 4 capital options.
  3. Correct answers build your streak for bonus points.
  4. Play through all 85 — how many can you get right?

❓ Frequently asked questions

How many questions are there?

85 countries and their capitals, asked in random order without repeats until the bank is exhausted.

How does scoring work?

Each question shows 4 options. Correct answers score 10 points plus a streak bonus.

What happens if I get one wrong?

A wrong answer resets your streak but you can keep playing indefinitely.

Are there hard questions too?

Yes — capitals range from famous ones to tricky ones like Ouagadougou and Ashgabat.
